# Images

Local image beside the file, embedded:

![a dot](dot.png)

Local image that doesn't exist, left alone:

![missing](missing.png)

Remote image with a title, left alone:

![remote](https://example.com/x.png "Remote Title")

Reference-style image: ![ref image][dot]

Image inside a link: [![linked dot](dot.png)](https://example.com)

Path with a space, URL-escaped: ![spaced](my%20dot.png)

[dot]: dot.png
